name: Ischial Tuberosity Avulsion Fracture
definition: Adolescent apophyseal avulsion of the ischial tuberosity at the hamstring origin, caused by sudden hip flexion with knee extension or sprinting.

investigations.principle: Pelvic radiographs are first-line; MRI/CT helps quantify displacement and soft-tissue injury.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Marked displacement or symptomatic nonunion may require surgery.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Shroni-bhagna/Snayu phenotype may be documented after modern imaging.

patientEducation.summary: Adolescent apophyseal avulsion of the ischial tuberosity at the hamstring origin, caused by sudden hip flexion with knee extension or sprinting.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
